+
+## Summary
+The project's test suite is currently failing due to what appears to be a configuration issue and missing dependencies. This brief is to investigate and resolve these issues to ensure a stable testing environment.
+
+## Acceptance criteria (BDD)
+GIVEN the development environment is set up according to the project's documentation
+WHEN the command `uv run pytest` is executed
+THEN all tests should pass without any errors.
+
+## Constraints / Non-goals
+- Do not add any new tests in this brief.
+- Do not refactor existing tests unless it is necessary to fix the failures.
+- Do not address any "skipped" or "xfail" tests. The focus is on fixing the errors.
+
+## Requested actions
+1. Investigate the root cause of the test failures, which seem to be related to `ModuleNotFoundError` and potentially missing dependencies like `pytest-bdd`.
+2. Update the project's dependencies and/or configuration to resolve these issues.
+3. Verify the fix by running the test suite and ensuring all tests pass.
+
+## Definition of done
+- The command `uv run pytest` completes successfully.
+- All tests in the test suite pass.
